profiler.port.description: The loopback port instrumented programs connect to (0: a free port each time IED starts). The Profile task passes it in IED_PROFILER; set it to use a fixed address for programs started outside IED.

profiler.targetFps.description: The frame rate the frame time graph draws its budget line at; frames over the budget are drawn in the warning color, frames over twice it in the error color.

profiler.followLive.description: A live capture's timeline scrolls with the newest data until you zoom or pan.

profiler.threadOrder.description: The order of the timeline's thread lanes, top to bottom: each entry a thread's name or a pattern (* any text, ? one character, case ignored). A thread goes where the first entry other than "*" that one of its names matches is, else where "*" is (after every entry without it); threads in one place keep the order they started in. A solution can set its own program's order.

profiler.gpuQueueOrder.description: The order of the GPU queues' lanes in the GPU group at the top of the timeline, as profiler.threadOrder orders threads: each entry a queue's name or a pattern.
